title: European Commission Inaugurates Europe's Largest Industrial Carbon Capture Facility
detail: The European Commission formally inaugurated Europe's largest commercial industrial carbon capture and storage facility on September 7, 2026, at Yara International's ammonia and fertiliser plant in Sluiskil, Zeeland province, the Netherlands. The facility will capture up to 800,000 tonnes of CO2 per year, liquefy it, and ship it to Norway's Northern Lights facility for permanent storage beneath the North Sea seabed -- an estimated 12 million tonnes over the project's 15-year life. Climate, Net-Zero and Clean Growth Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra attended the inauguration, calling it a strategic investment in 'practical climate solutions that deliver real emissions reductions while strengthening industrial competitiveness.' The project has drawn criticism from environmental groups, who argue it risks billions in public money on an unproven technology that delays deeper decarbonization of hard-to-abate industry.

media.caption: Commissioner Wopke Hoekstra at the inauguration of the Yara Sluiskil carbon capture facility, Netherlands, September 7, 2026

title: UNEP: Every $1 Invested in Coordinated Climate and Clean-Air Action Returns $15
detail: The UN Environment Programme and the Climate and Clean Air Coalition released a report on September 7, 2026 -- 'Hidden Assets: The Economic and Health Case for Climate and Clean Air Action' -- finding that every US$1 invested in coordinated climate and clean-air measures can generate around US$15 in economic and health benefits, a higher return than tackling the two issues separately. The assessment, described as the first comprehensive global economic analysis of integrated climate and clean-air action, models 25 proven policy measures and finds the benefit-cost ratio reflects both direct market gains and the monetized value of fewer premature deaths and improved public health.

media.caption: UNEP/CCAC report finds coordinated climate and clean-air action returns $15 for every $1 invested
